18	/**
19	 * Derives the stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household, i.e. who share a
20	 * last name and postcode. The last name is normalized (case-insensitively, with collapsed
21	 * whitespace) and joined to the postcode with {@code '|'}; the identifier is the leading hex
22	 * characters of the SHA-256 digest of that pair. Because it is a deterministic digest, every owner
23	 * with the same last name and postcode computes the same value automatically, and it never changes
24	 * as members join or leave.
25	 */
26	public final class HouseholdIdGenerator {
27	
28	    /** Number of leading hex characters of the digest kept as the identifier. */
29	    private static final int LENGTH = 12;
30	
31	    private HouseholdIdGenerator() {
32	    }

35	     * Produce the household identifier for the given last name and postcode, or {@code null} when
36	     * no postcode is on file (an owner without a postcode belongs to no shared household).
37	     *
38	     * @param lastName the household's last name

## Overview

This is a Spring PetClinic REST app. The identity concepts live in three layers: **`model`** utility/value types that compute the identifiers, the **`Owner`** entity that exposes them as derived getters, the **`service.CustomerCodeGenerator`** that mints + de-duplicates the code, and the **OpenAPI schema** (`openapi.yml`) that declares the read-only DTO fields. There is currently **no `memberId`** in main source — it exists only as the *target* unified field asserted by the acceptance test. Below, file by file.

---

## 1. `CustomerCode` value type (the region-and-hash identity format)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/CustomerCode.java`

Owns the `'<REGION>-<HASH8>'` format. HASH8 = first 8 UPPER-case hex of SHA-256.
- L33 `SEPARATOR = '-'`, L36 `HASH_LENGTH = 8`
- L49-51 `of(region, normalizedTelephone, lastName)` → `region + '-' + Sha256.hexPrefix(normalizedTelephone + lastName, 8)` — **this is where the SHA-256-over-(telephone+lastName) first-8-hex identity is assembled**
- L59-65 `regionOf(String customerCode)` → substring before first `-` (used for locality)

## 2. `Sha256` (where the hash is actually computed)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Sha256.java`
- L40-47 `hexPrefix(input, length)` → UPPER-case (`%02X`) hex prefix — used by `CustomerCode` (len 8) and `HouseholdIdGenerator` (len 12)
- L56-63 `hex(input)` → full 64-char lower-case (`%02x`) digest — used by `Owner.getIdentityKey()`
- L65-71 `digest(input)` → `MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")` over UTF-8 bytes

## 3. `Luhn` (where the check digit is computed)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Luhn.java`
- L38-57 `checkDigit(String value)` → standard Luhn over digits only (non-digits skipped); `return (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10`. Called by `Owner.getCheckDigit()` over the customerCode string.

## 4. `FiscalYear` (where fiscal year is computed)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/FiscalYear.java`
- L33 `START_MONTH = Month.JULY`
- L45-47 `of(LocalDate)` → year+1 if month ≥ July else year
- L56-58 `yearSegment(date)` → `of(date) % 100` (the `YY` used in membership number)
- L66-71 `label(date)` → `String.format("FY%02d", yearSegment(date))` (the `FY27` field)
- L83-85 `elapsedYears(start, end)` → `of(end) - of(start)` (owner tenure)

## 5. `Owner` entity — all derived getters
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
- L77-78 field `@Column(name="customer_code") private String customerCode;` (the only persisted identity field; L80-81 `household_id`)
- L244-250 `getCustomerCode()` / `setCustomerCode()`
- L260-262 `getPrimaryIdentifier()` → returns `getCustomerCode()` (indirection point; doc says it will become the member id)
- **L270-275 `getMembershipNumber()`** → `String.format("%s-M%02d", customerCode, FiscalYear.yearSegment(registrationDate))`; null if customerCode or registrationDate null → e.g. `NSW-3F2A9C1D-M27`
- **L283-285 `getFiscalYear()`** → `FiscalYear.label(registrationDate)`
- **L291-296 `getCheckDigit()`** → `Luhn.checkDigit(customerCode)`; null if no customerCode
- L190-192 `getLocality()` → `CustomerCode.regionOf(customerCode)` (region read back from the code, NOT recomputed)
- L200-202 `getTimezone()` → `RegionTimezone.zoneFor(getLocality())`
- L315-321 `getIdentityKey()` → `Sha256.hex(telephone|lowerEmail|Soundex(lastName))` (duplicate detection, separate from customerCode)
- L408-413 `getTenureFiscalYears()` → `FiscalYear.elapsedYears(registrationDate, now)`
- L423-425 `getOwnerSegment()` → `OwnerSegment.of(getMembershipLevel(), getLocality())`
- L337-386 `getMembershipPoints()` / `getMembershipLevel()` (points→level, capped by `membershipLevelCap`)
- L118-121 `@PrePersist resolveRegistrationDate()` (weekend/holiday roll via `RegistrationDatePolicy`, affects fiscal-year segment)

## 6. `CustomerCodeGenerator` — generation + collision handling
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/CustomerCodeGenerator.java`
- L41 `FIRST_SUFFIX = 2`
- L56-60 `generate(owner)` → `region = Locality.of(city, postcode)`, `code = CustomerCode.of(region, telephone, lastName)`, then `deduplicate(code)`
- **L66-76 `deduplicate(code)` — collision handling**: if `ownerRepository.existsByCustomerCode(code)` returns true, appends `-2`, `-3`, … until a free one is found

## 7. `OwnerSegment` — the "owner segment" logic
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/OwnerSegment.java`
- L32 `PREMIUM_MIN_LEVEL = 3`, L35 `METRO_REGIONS = {"NSW","VIC","QLD"}`
- L49-51 `of(membershipLevel, locality)` → `tier + "_" + area`
- L53-54 tier: PREMIUM if level ≥ 3 else STANDARD; L57-58 area: METRO if locality in set else REGIONAL

## 8. Region lookup tables
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Locality.java` — L40-43 `of(city, postcode)`: postcode range wins, else city table
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/CityRegion.java` — L32-35 map Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD; L30 `UNKNOWN`; L47-49 `regionFor(city)`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/PostcodeRegion.java` — L32-35 ranges NSW 2000-2099 / VIC 3000-3099 / QLD 4000-4099; L47-65 `regionFor(postcode)`; L73-75 `hasRange(region)`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/RegionTimezone.java` — L29-32 region→IANA tz; L44-46 `zoneFor(region)`

## 9. `HouseholdIdGenerator` (separate SHA-256 identity, 12-hex)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/HouseholdIdGenerator.java`
- L29 `LENGTH = 12`; L43-49 `generate(lastName, postcode)` → `Sha256.hexPrefix(normalize(lastName)+"|"+postcode, 12)`; null when postcode blank. Called at `OwnerRestControllerV1` L190.

## 10. Audit records + "owner created" event

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/OwnerCreatedEvent.java` — L28-29 record `(long seq, Integer ownerId, String customerCode, Integer membershipLevel, String event)`; L40-42 convenience ctor uses `owner.getPrimaryIdentifier()` for the `customerCode` slot. L32 `OWNER_CREATED`.
- Called from `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java` L201 (fields injected L109, L117, L123)

## 11. Where customerCode is assigned & persisted
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java` — L50/L63/L74 inject generator; **L253-268 `saveOwner`**: L255-257 `if (owner.getCustomerCode()==null) owner.setCustomerCode(customerCodeGenerator.generate(owner))`
- Repository `existsByCustomerCode` (the collision query):
  - Interface: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java` L86
  - JPA: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java` L108-111
  - JDBC: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jdbc/JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl.java` L155-159 (`WHERE customer_code = :customerCode`)
  - Spring Data: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/springdatajpa/SpringDataOwnerRepository.java` L72

## 12. DTO / API schema (generated `OwnerDto` source of truth)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — `OwnerDto` properties (all `readOnly`):
- L2168-2178 `customerCode` (`<REGION>-<HASH8>`, example `NSW-3F2A9C1D`)
- L2179-2188 `membershipNumber` (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`, example `NSW-3F2A9C1D-M27`)
- L2189-2198 `fiscalYear` (`FY<YY>`, example `FY27`)
- L2199-2208 `checkDigit` (integer 0-9, Luhn over customer code, example `7`)
- L2209-2231 `membershipPoints` / `membershipLevel`
- L2232-2240 `householdId`; L2241-2250 `identityKey`
- L2257-2266 `locality`; L2267-2277 `timezone`
- L2338-2352 `ownerSegment` (enum PREMIUM_METRO / PREMIUM_REGIONAL / STANDARD_METRO / STANDARD_REGIONAL)

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). Optional; when
            present it is prefixed to the owner's last name to form the
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and this value is returned as the composed address string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address,
            appended to 'addressLine1' in the composed address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid
            for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9()+\-.\s]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present, the owner's
            'ageBand' is derived from it against the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title followed by a space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title
                is on file.
              type: string
              example: DR Who
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the
                region derived from the owner's postcode, a hyphen, and HASH8 —
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the owner's
                normalized telephone concatenated with its last name. A stable
                identity derived from owner fields, with no sequence numbers.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3F2A9C1D
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the two-digit segment of the fiscal year of the
                registration date (a fiscal year starts on 1 July and is numbered
                by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: NSW-3F2A9C1D-M27
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The 'FY<YY>' label of the fiscal year the registration date falls
                in, where a fiscal year starts on 1 July and is numbered by the
                calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027
                is 'FY27'). Null when no registration date is on file.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customer code.
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a score derived from the owner's
                own fields: starting at 0, plus 2 when a contact email is on
                file, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes, plus 2 for a
                household of 3 or more, and plus 3 when the owner's tenure
                reaches one or more elapsed fiscal years.
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 mapped from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by every owner who knowingly shares a
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true; null otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F2A9C1D4B6E8071
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value used to detect duplicate owners: the 64-character
                lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lower-cased email or empty>|<Soundex code of last name>'.
                Two owners are the same person only when their identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: 'a3f5c9d2e1b4a6f8c0d2e4f6a8b0c2d4e6f8a0b2c4d6e8f0a2b4c6d8e0f2a4b6'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region: the region component of the
                customer code, which was derived from the owner's postcode (and
                city) when the identity was assigned. Null when no customer code
                is assigned.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone: the IANA name derived from the owner's
                locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane). Null when the locality is absent or has no
                known timezone.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed when this owner was
                created and share its first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning

                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on the
                current business day, signalling an unusually high signup volume;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners, signalling that it is approaching the per-city capacity
                limit of 50; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-

                existing owner's last name and postcode but has a different
                telephone; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                last name and postcode, different telephone), or null when there
                is no such match.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              type: string
              enum:

              readOnly: true

              type: string
              enum:

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). Optional; when
            present it is prefixed to the owner's last name to form the
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and this value is returned as the composed address string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address,
            appended to 'addressLine1' in the composed address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid
            for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9()+\-.\s]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present, the owner's
            'ageBand' is derived from it against the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title followed by a space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title
                is on file.
              type: string
              example: DR Who
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the
                region derived from the owner's postcode, the two-digit fiscal
                year of the registration date, HASH8 — the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the owner's normalized telephone
                concatenated with its last name — and a single Luhn check digit
                computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. A stable
                identity derived from owner fields, with no sequence numbers.
              type: string
              example: NSW273F2A9C1D5
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The 'FY<YY>' label read from the two-digit fiscal-year segment of
                the member id, which was set to the fiscal year the registration
                date falls in when the identity was minted, where a fiscal year
                starts on 1 July and is numbered by the calendar year in which it
                ends (e.g. 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 is 'FY27'). Null when no
                member id is assigned.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a score derived from the owner's
                own fields: starting at 0, plus 2 when a contact email is on
                file, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes, plus 2 for a
                household of 3 or more, and plus 3 when the owner's tenure
                reaches one or more elapsed fiscal years.
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 mapped from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by every owner who knowingly shares a
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true; null otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F2A9C1D4B6E8071
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value used to detect duplicate owners: the 64-character
                lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lower-cased email or empty>|<Soundex code of last name>'.
                Two owners are the same person only when their identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: 'a3f5c9d2e1b4a6f8c0d2e4f6a8b0c2d4e6f8a0b2c4d6e8f0a2b4c6d8e0f2a4b6'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region: the region component of the
                customer code, which was derived from the owner's postcode (and
                city) when the identity was assigned. Null when no customer code
                is assigned.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone: the IANA name derived from the owner's
                locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane). Null when the locality is absent or has no
                known timezone.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed when this owner was
                created and share its first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on the
                current business day, signalling an unusually high signup volume;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners, signalling that it is approaching the per-city capacity
                limit of 50; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, while not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode but has a different
                telephone; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                last name and postcode, different telephone), or null when there
                is no such match.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the fields on
                file: 'EMAIL' when a contact email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the membership level is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
